name: Kalutara Bodhiya
short_description: A revered Bodhi tree and Buddhist temple beside the Kalu River.
description: Kalutara Bodhiya is a Buddhist religious site on the Colombo–Galle road near the Kalu River. The sacred Bodhi tree, temple, and nearby white stupa form a prominent religious landmark in Kalutara.
visitor_information: Confirm current access, opening hours, and any admission charges before travelling.

photo.alt_text: Kalutara Bodhiya is an old Bodhi tree which is identified as one of the 32 saplings of Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi which was planted during the reign of king Devanampiyatissa in the 2nd century BC at Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka.

short_description: A zoological garden with animal exhibits and educational displays.
description: The National Zoological Gardens at Dehiwala is operated by the Department of National Zoological Gardens. Visitors can see a collection of mammals, birds, reptiles, and other animals. Check the official website for current visitor arrangements.
visitor_information: Confirm current access, opening hours, and any admission charges before travelling.
